caveat.block_ratio: Blocking is judged through the profile''s action map. A higher block ratio describes the IPS''s decisions; it does not establish that an attack succeeded.
caveat.destination_rate: More events towards a destination describe traffic volume, not an attack on it.
caveat.new_port: A newly busy destination port may be a deployment as easily as a probe. The contributors are the bucket''s busiest source IPs, not necessarily this port''s.
caveat.port_fanout: Many distinct destination ports from one source IP is a traffic shape, not an attack verdict: a scan, a vulnerability assessment and a service that rotates ports look alike.
caveat.port_rate: More events on a port describe traffic volume, not intent: a scan, a deployment and a misconfigured client look alike here.
caveat.signature_burst: A burst of one signature describes how often the IPS matched it, not that the matched activity succeeded.
caveat.source_concentration: A dominant source IP describes traffic composition, not intent. Behind a proxy or NAT it is the intermediary''s address.

concentration.fired: the largest source IP sent {top} of {total} events ({share}), against an expected share of {expected} ({rise}); the five largest sent {top5}; {basis}
concentration.fired_no_top5: the largest source IP sent {top} of {total} events ({share}), against an expected share of {expected} ({rise}); the five largest sent n/a; {basis}
concentration.top_below_min: the largest source IP sent {top} events, below the {minimum} minimum for a material concentration
concentration.total_below_min: {total} events is below the {minimum} minimum for a composition verdict

draft.scope_id_number: scope_id of a {kind} scope is a number
draft.scope_id_uuid: scope_id of a LOG_SOURCE scope is the source''s id
draft.scope_must_be_empty: {column} must be empty for a {kind} scope
draft.series_max: at most {max} values per request, not {count}
draft.series_untracked: value {value} is not a tracked value of this watch''s current version
draft.type_missing: log source type {id} is not in the synced inventory

history.starts_next: the reading starts at the next collection
history.unreadable: the stored history progress could not be read back

history_change.already_collected: this watch has already collected ({marks} set); create a new watch to read history
history_change.already_requested: history is {state} on this watch and cannot be requested again; create a new watch to read history
history_change.holds_buckets: this watch holds {stored} stored bucket(s) of its current version; create a new watch to read history

history_check.admission_truncated: history bucket {bucket} had truncated value admission
history_check.bucket_coverage: history bucket {bucket} had parsing coverage below the floor
history_check.bucket_never_collected: history bucket {bucket} was never collected ({missing} of {expected} missing)
history_check.bucket_version: history bucket {bucket} used another watch version, not first-appearance version {version}
history_check.bucket_width: history bucket {bucket} used a different collection bucket width
history_check.discovery_truncated: history bucket {bucket} had truncated value discovery
history_check.first_bucket_never_collected: the first-appearance bucket was never collected
history_check.not_divisible: the history window is not divisible by the collection bucket width
history_check.record_count: the history contains {records} bucket records for {expected} expected buckets

preview.cut_at_row_limit: the grouped search was cut at the row limit and a preview does not split it; narrow the scope or preview a type or a source
preview.group_too_large: the group resolves to {members} sources and a preview covers one search chunk of at most {max}; preview a smaller group, a type or a source
preview.lower_bound: a bucket was cut at the row limit: its counts are lower bounds
preview.search_failed: a search failed, so its buckets were not measured
preview.unsearchable: the stored watch cannot be searched: {error}

reference.name_invalid: invalid QRadar property name: letters, digits, underscore, space and hyphen only, at most 64 characters
reference.name_not_text: property reference name must be text
reference.normalized_not_allowed: normalized field is not in the property-watch allowlist
reference.not_an_object: a property reference is an object with a kind and a name
reference.pin_characters: a pinned value cannot hold a quote, a backslash, a control character or leading or trailing whitespace
reference.pin_empty: a pinned value cannot be empty
reference.pin_length: a pinned value is at most {max} characters

scope.group_empty: the group and its descendants hold no synced log source
scope.group_missing: the log source group is not in the inventory
scope.group_stale: the group inventory was last synced at {synced}, older than {limit}
scope.names_no_group: the watch names no log source group
scope.names_no_type: the watch names no log source type
scope.source_missing: the log source is not in the inventory
scope.too_large: {sources} sources need {searches} searches; the limit is {limit}
scope.type_empty: no synced log source has this type

status.evaluated: the latest collected bucket was evaluated
status.latest_search_failed: the latest search failed; bucket {bucket} is stored NOT_COLLECTED
status.not_applicable: the property parsed on no event in scope; the values are not measured
status.open: one or more value incidents are open
status.reading_history: Reading history from QRadar: {done} of {total} days; nothing is judged until it finishes
status.recovering: one or more value incidents are recovering

rule_health.age_unknown: The rule''s age is unknown, so inactivity cannot be assessed.
rule_health.dependency_degraded: The rule cannot fire reliably: {dependencies}. Its silence is not evidence about the rule itself.
rule_health.dependency_unobserved: A dependency has not been observed, so the rule cannot be judged: {dependencies}.
rule_health.disabled: The rule is disabled in QRadar, so it cannot produce detections.
rule_health.grace: The rule is {age_days} days old, inside the {grace_days}-day grace period.

healthy.direct: The rule fired {count} times in the evaluation window with healthy dependencies.
healthy.inferred: At least {count} offense-contributing firings were observed in the evaluation window with healthy dependencies.
healthy.lower_bound: At least {count} matching events were measured in the evaluation window with healthy dependencies.

rule_health.inactive: The rule last fired {quiet_days} days ago, beyond the {inactivity_days}-day inactivity window.

cause.failed_many_class: {count} windows failed to collect (latest error class: {error_class})
cause.failed_one_class: 1 window failed to collect (latest error class: {error_class})
cause.skipped_many: {count} windows were skipped beyond the catch-up horizon and never searched
cause.skipped_one: 1 window was skipped beyond the catch-up horizon and never searched

incomplete.detail_many: Measured rule-match coverage of the evaluation window is incomplete ({complete} of {expected} windows are COMPLETE): {causes}. Affected windows: {first_start} to {last_start}. The absence of measured matches is not evidence that the rule has never fired. The evaluation window stops holding the last affected window at {until}.
incomplete.detail_one: Measured rule-match coverage of the evaluation window is incomplete ({complete} of {expected} windows are COMPLETE): {causes}. Affected window: {first_start}. The absence of measured matches is not evidence that the rule has never fired. The evaluation window stops holding the last affected window at {until}.
incomplete.head: Measured rule-match coverage of the evaluation window is incomplete ({complete} of {expected} windows are COMPLETE), so the absence of measured matches is not evidence that the rule has never fired.
incomplete.no_collection: No completed rule-metric collection covers the evaluation window, so the absence of observed firings is not evidence that the rule has never fired.

rule_health.min_history: Not enough observed history to classify this rule.

never_observed.measured: The rule is enabled and its dependencies are healthy, but no matching event was measured in any of the {expected} COMPLETE windows of the evaluation span.
never_observed.unmeasured: The rule is enabled and its dependencies are healthy, but it has never been observed firing in {age_days} days.

rule_health.noisy: The rule fired {per_day} times a day over the last {window_days} days, above the expected {threshold}.

cost.label: QRadar capacity benchmark: how fast the rule could be evaluated. Lower is costlier to evaluate. This is not a firing rate.
cost.unit: millions of events per second (QRadar''s unit)

silent.excluded: Only EVENT rules and EVENT building blocks are judged: an event search sees every one of their matches. COMMON rules also match on flows, which are not searched, so their silence is unknown. FLOW and OFFENSE rules are not searched at all.

window.incomplete: Only {complete} of {expected} windows in the span are complete ({missing} missing, {truncated} truncated, {failed} failed). Absence from an incomplete window proves nothing.
window.none: No rule-match window has been collected for this instance: collection is disabled or has not run yet, so nothing is measured.
window.unsettled: No rule-match window in the requested span has settled yet.

ruledraft.column_must_be_empty: {column} must stay empty for a {kind} rule
ruledraft.enabled_cap: at most {max_enabled} rules may be enabled at once ({enabled_count} already are)
ruledraft.metric_unknown: metric {metric} is not in the custom-rule catalog
ruledraft.metric_wrong_kind: metric {metric} measures a {metric_kind} subject, not a {kind} one
ruledraft.operator_unknown: operator {operator} is not one of GT, GE, LT, LE, EQ
ruledraft.pw_value_not_pinned: property-watch value {id} is not pinned; a rule can watch only a pinned value, so pin it on its property watch first
ruledraft.source_class_unknown: source_class {value} is not a known source class
ruledraft.threshold_not_finite: threshold_value must be a finite number
ruledraft.threshold_share: a {metric} threshold is a share and must lie strictly between 0 and 1

aql.no_dataset: query must select FROM events or flows
aql.no_time_window: query must include a bounded time window (LAST N ..., or START/STOP)
aql.not_select: query must be a single SELECT statement

budget.full: the Ariel search budget is full ({held} in flight); waited {waited} s; nothing was sent to QRadar

cron.below_floor: schedule_cron {cron} ({timezone}) fires {gap} seconds apart ({previous} then {next}); a search must fire at least {min_seconds} seconds apart
cron.invalid: schedule_cron {cron} ({timezone}) is not a valid cron expression: {error}
cron.no_future_fire: schedule_cron {cron} ({timezone}) has no future fire time

run.capacity: No Ariel permit became available within {waited} seconds (per-console cap {instance_cap}, global cap {global_cap})

threshold.unreachable: threshold {operator} {threshold} can never be reached: a run counts at most max_result_rows ({max_result_rows}) rows; raise max_result_rows above the threshold or lower the threshold

field.insufficient_coverage: populated on {populated} of events, below the required {required}
field.no_events: the source produced no events in the window; nothing can be concluded
field.total_not_measured: the source''s total event volume was not measured

field.not_mapped: no QRadar field is mapped to this logical field
field.rejected: QRadar rejected the mapped field as named
field.unpopulated: the field exists but no event in the window carried a usable value

input.action_needs_field: an action map needs an ACTION field mapping
input.action_overlap: an action value is mapped to both BLOCKED and ALLOWED
input.action_value: invalid {outcome} action value: use a printable token of at most {max_length} characters
input.normalized_field: normalized field is not in the IPS allowlist
input.property_name: invalid QRadar property name: letters, digits, underscore, space and hyphen only, at most 64 characters

profile.truncated: the bounded validation probe was truncated

conflict.missing: the profile does not exist; create it with expected_profile_version null
conflict.not_validated: profile version {profile_version} has not validated (status {validation_status}); run validation first
conflict.running: validation of version {profile_version} is already running since {since}
conflict.version: profile version conflict; current version is {current}

ineligible.version_never_validated: profile version {profile_version} has never been validated
ineligible.version_not_validated: profile version {profile_version} has not been validated (last validated: {validated_profile_version})

profile.source_missing: the log source does not exist in QRadar
profile.total_not_measured: total event volume was not measured ({error})

field.implausible_no_values: no values of sampled events carry a plausible {logical} value, below the required {required}
field.implausible_ratio: {plausible} of sampled events carry a plausible {logical} value, below the required {required}
field.not_mapped: no QRadar property is mapped to this field
field.property_rejected: QRadar rejected a query naming this property; it does not exist as named
field.unpopulated: the property exists but no event in the window carried a value

ineligible.monitoring_disabled: monitoring is disabled for the log source
ineligible.source_missing: the profile''s log source no longer exists

input.action_needs_property: an action map needs an action property
input.action_overlap: action values mapped to both BLOCKED and ALLOWED: {values}
input.action_value: invalid {outcome} action value {value}: a printable token of at most {max_length} characters
input.property_name: invalid QRadar property name {name}: letters, digits, underscore, space and hyphen only, at most 64 characters

basis.mad_above_p95: robust score unavailable (MAD=0); {observed} is above the historical p95 {bound}
basis.mad_outside_band: robust score unavailable (MAD=0); observed value is outside the expected band [{lower}, {upper}]
basis.mad_within_p95: robust score unavailable (MAD=0) and {observed} is within the historical p95 {bound}

caveat.block_ratio: Blocking is judged through the profile''s action map. A higher block ratio describes WAF decisions; it does not establish that an attack succeeded.
caveat.client_concentration: A dominant source IP describes traffic composition, not intent.
caveat.client_error_ratio: HTTP 4xx responses are response codes, not WAF decisions: a 403 is not by itself a block, and WAF blocking is reported separately.
caveat.new_endpoint: A newly requested endpoint may be a deployment as easily as a probe.
caveat.server_error_ratio: HTTP 5xx responses describe server-side failures. They do not establish that the traffic was malicious.

concentration.attributed_low: only {covered} of the endpoint''s requests were attributed to a source IP, below the {floor} coverage floor
concentration.endpoint_below_min: {count} requests is below the {minimum} minimum for a composition verdict
concentration.fired: the largest source IP sent {top} of {total} requests to {subject} ({share}), against an expected share of {expected} ({rise}); the five largest sent {top5}; {volume}; {basis}
concentration.rise_below_min: the largest source IP''s share {share} is {rise} from the expected {expected}, below the {minimum} minimum rise
concentration.top_below_min: the largest source IP sent {top} requests, below the {minimum} minimum for a material concentration
concentration.volume_no_baseline: endpoint volume {requests} requests (no reliable volume baseline)
concentration.volume_with_baseline: endpoint volume {requests} requests against an expected {expected}

guard.baseline_no_denominator: the {metric} baseline has no pooled denominator
guard.baseline_samples: the {metric} baseline has {samples} material bucket(s), below the minimum for a defensible verdict
guard.breakdown_failed: the {breakdown} breakdown failed for this bucket: the value is unavailable, not zero
guard.breakdown_not_collected: the {breakdown} breakdown was not collected for this bucket: the value is unavailable, not zero
guard.no_baseline: no {metric} baseline for this weekday/hour cell yet
guard.not_proven_lower_bound: {reason}; the numerator is a lower bound ({scope}), so a normal verdict cannot be concluded from it
guard.source_coverage_low: only {covered} of this source''s events parsed to an endpoint, below the {floor} coverage floor: the unparsed requests may differ in kind from the parsed ones, so the visible proportion bounds nothing

history_check.admission_truncated: history bucket {bucket} had truncated endpoint admission
history_check.appearance_never_collected: the first-appearance bucket was never collected
history_check.appearance_no_profile: the first-appearance bucket carries no profile version
history_check.appearance_normalizer: the first-appearance bucket is incompatible with endpoint normalizer version {version}
history_check.bucket_width: history bucket {bucket} used a different collection bucket width
history_check.discovery_truncated: history bucket {bucket} had truncated endpoint discovery
history_check.never_collected: {missing} of {expected} history buckets were never collected
history_check.normalizer_version: history bucket {bucket} is incompatible with endpoint normalizer version {version}
history_check.not_divisible: the history window is not divisible by the collection bucket width
history_check.not_loaded: history was not loaded for an established endpoint
history_check.profile_version: history bucket {bucket} used profile version {found}, not first-appearance version {expected}
history_check.record_count: the history contains {records} bucket records for {expected} expected buckets

novelty.below_materiality: {requests} request(s) in {buckets} bucket(s) since first appearance has not reached {min_requests} requests in {min_buckets} buckets
novelty.established_hand_off: established endpoint: first admitted {first_seen} before the history hand-off {hand_off}
novelty.established_outside_window: established endpoint: first admitted {first_seen}, outside the {buckets}-bucket novelty window
novelty.fired: {subject} received {requests} requests across {buckets} buckets since it first appeared at {first_seen}; in the verified history {history_start} to {history_end} it was never requested {admission} or more times in one bucket
novelty.fired_lower: {subject} received at least {requests} requests across {buckets} buckets since it first appeared at {first_seen}; in the verified history {history_start} to {history_end} it was never requested {admission} or more times in one bucket
novelty.flood_admission: endpoint admission was truncated in the first-appearance bucket
novelty.flood_discovery: endpoint discovery was truncated in the first-appearance bucket
novelty.not_established: the endpoint''s first appearance was not established

rate.baseline_samples: baseline has {samples} sample(s), below the minimum required for a defensible verdict
rate.below_min_volume: {observed} requests/bucket is below the {minimum} minimum for a defensible verdict
rate.bucket_not_whole: bucket is {completeness}, not a whole observation
rate.coverage_low: only {covered} of this source''s events carried a parseable endpoint in this bucket
rate.delta_below_min: increase of {delta} requests/bucket is below the {minimum} minimum absolute delta
rate.fired: {observed} requests is above the baseline median {expected} ({ratio_text}, +{delta} requests/bucket); {basis}
rate.fired_lower: at least {observed} requests (a lower bound: {scope}) is above the baseline median {expected} ({ratio_text}, +{delta} requests/bucket); {basis}
rate.mad_within_band: robust score unavailable (MAD=0) and observed value is inside the expected band [{lower}, {upper}]
rate.no_baseline: no request-rate baseline for this weekday/hour cell yet
rate.not_proven_lower_bound: at least {observed} requests were attributed to this endpoint, but the count is a lower bound and {reason}; a normal verdict cannot be concluded from a lower bound
rate.z_not_reached: robust z={score} has not reached the +{threshold} threshold

ratio.denominator_below_min: {count} {noun} is below the {minimum} minimum denominator for a ratio verdict
ratio.field_coverage_low: only {covered} of the endpoint''s requests carried the {field} field, below the {floor} coverage floor
ratio.fired: {count} of {total} {denominator} to {subject} were {numerator} ({share}), against an expected {expected} from {history} historical requests ({rise}, {multiple}x); {basis}
ratio.fired_lower: at least {count} of {total} {denominator} to {subject} were {numerator} (at least {share}), against an expected {expected} from {history} historical requests ({rise}, {multiple}x); {basis}
ratio.fired_lower_no_multiple: at least {count} of {total} {denominator} to {subject} were {numerator} (at least {share}), against an expected {expected} from {history} historical requests ({rise}); {basis}
ratio.fired_no_multiple: {count} of {total} {denominator} to {subject} were {numerator} ({share}), against an expected {expected} from {history} historical requests ({rise}); {basis}
ratio.numerator_below_min: {count} {noun} is below the {minimum} minimum; no material rise in the proportion is possible
ratio.rise_below_min: {observed} is {rise} from the expected {expected}, below the {minimum} minimum rise

scope.inputs_unsupported: the inputs do not support a verdict
scope.lower_bound_increase: the count is a lower bound: an increase can be proven, normal behaviour cannot
scope.needs_exact: the detector needs exact counts and this count is a lower bound
scope.unattributed: some events could not be attributed
scope.unstated: the bucket does not state whether its counts are exact or lower bounds

semantics.baseline_unidentified: the baseline cell carries no metric-semantics identity; rebuild required
semantics.bucket_unidentified: the bucket carries no metric-semantics identity; it was collected before identities were recorded and cannot be judged
semantics.mismatch: the baseline was built under ''{baseline}'' but the bucket was collected under ''{bucket}''; rebuild required
